question: is sars-cov-2 rising in virginia over the last 2 weeks?

statements: SELECT MAX(sample_collect_date) AS latest_sample_date FROM wastewater.sars_cov_2 WHERE pcr_target = 'sars-cov-2'
SELECT MAX(sample_collect_date) AS latest_sample_date FROM wastewater.sars_cov_2 WHERE pcr_target = 'sars-cov-2' AND state_territory = 'va'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS samples, SUM(CASE WHEN pcr_target_detect = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positives, COUNT(DISTINCT site) AS sites, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(pcr_target_avg_conc, ',', '') AS DOUBLE)) AS mean_conc FROM wastewater.sars_cov_2 WHERE pcr_target = 'sars-cov-2' AND sample_collect_date >= '2026-10-10' AND sample_collect_date <= '2026-10-23' AND state_territory = 'va'

SELECT pcr_target_units AS units, COUNT(*) AS samples FROM wastewater.sars_cov_2 WHERE pcr_target = 'sars-cov-2' AND sample_collect_date >= '2026-10-10' AND sample_collect_date <= '2026-10-23' AND state_territory = 'va' GROUP BY pcr_target_units ORDER BY samples DESC
